decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The dwelling incorporating the basement, shall not be used any time other than for a single dwelling. The basement shall at no time be used or occupied separately from the existing dwelling (22 Wavendon Avenue, Chiswick, London W4 4NR).
Condition : 5 - The additional rooms to the basement hereby approved shall only be used for uses incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse and not used as main living rooms or bedrooms.

Condition : 6 - The erection of single storey side extension and creation of basement level with covered light well at rear of house, as shown on drawing number 115.120 Revision A received 31 July 2006 and 115.220 received 4 August 2006 (Amended plans), is satisfactory as the development would respect the original character of the house and would maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension and creation of non habitable rooms at basement level with covered lightwell to rear of house
